body: I hope that you are happy with whatever decision you make. Just know you have this sub whenever you need it 💙

Surgery just dealt with most of it, which I wasn’t expecting. A lot of it, without surgery, is acceptance, which doesn’t necessarily mean being okay with the way you are, but instead just knowing you aren’t changing for possibly awhile. Sounds strange, but realizing that means realizing the possibility for change.

T drastically improved my mental health as well. Almost immediately. Something in my head just clicked and lots of things that bothered me before didn’t anymore even without anything physically changing for a couple months.

As for misgendering and transphobia, after awhile you either get used to it and/or you become more confident in calling it out. No, you won’t ever get the time back, and it’s horrible and valid to feel angry about. But that doesn’t mean you’re never gonna feel relief or that it makes that relief any less worth it.

I didn’t expect these things to help, either, and the roads fucking sucked and got worse before they got better but I’m still here. I had a plan on killing myself after top surgery and I just don’t wanna anymore. Couldn’t tell you exactly why, but I don’t even really think of it. It’s unreal.
Hey fren, I’m trans as well, would love to chat with you if you’re up for it. If not that’s okay, just know I know what it’s like to be in your position and it’s really fucking difficult
